Push a pumpkin onto every burrow to keep the raccoon bandits out of the bear’s garden. The bear can push one pumpkin when the square beyond it is clear. He cannot pull. A pumpkin pushed against the wrong hedge may be stuck; Undo takes it back.

Arrow keys or WASD walk. Click an empty square to walk there, or a pumpkin beside the bear to push it. Z, U or Backspace undo; R starts this garden over. Hint points to a useful next push. H or F1 opens Help.

Gardens opens the garden book. Previous and Next season page through all 243 gardens. The first two sections are open from the start. Clear half of a section to unlock the next. Finish a garden to keep a bronze pumpkin, come close to its verified best push count for silver, or match the best for gold. New garden advances to the next available garden; Start over retries this one. Completed gardens can always be replayed from the book.

The five Endless choices generate fresh gardens for spring, summer, autumn, winter and night. Each is generated backwards from a solved position and verified by the forward solver before play. If a garden takes a moment to grow, the current scene stays visible.

Every committed move is saved. Reopening resumes the same garden, pumpkins and undo history. The suite’s Music, Sound and Motion switches apply here too. With reduced motion, moves and their results appear immediately.
